title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: performance
text:
performance guarantee
performance guarantee
(definition)
Definition:
An expression of the most the result of an
approximation algorithm
may depart from the
optimal solution
.
See also
absolute performance guarantee
,
relative performance guarantee
,
optimization problem
.
Note:
